products.text:
Type: two-seat leatherette sofa
Use: sitting, lounging; living room, home office
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: smooth faux leather upholstery, dark wooden block feet
Colors: black, dark brown feet
Shape: plump padded back with tufted square panels, flared rolled arms, single long seat cushion with stitched sections, low hidden feet, compact but bulky
Feel: sleek, solid, practical
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood, patterned rugs; modern living rooms and offices

Type: three-seat tufted sofa
Use: sitting, lounging; living room
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: woven tweed-like fabric, polished chrome metal legs
Colors: dark charcoal grey, silver
Shape: three button-tufted back cushions, long single bench seat, flared sloping track arms, slim tapered metal legs, raised and light
Feel: tailored, sleek, calm
Goes with: white walls, walnut wood, chrome or glass accents; modern or mid-century rooms

Type: outdoor deep-seat loveseat
Use: sitting, lounging outdoors; patio, porch, garden
Style: contemporary, traditional
Materials: powder-coated metal frame, thick fabric seat and back cushions
Colors: light warm beige, dark bronze brown frame
Shape: two plump back and seat cushions, slim open metal frame with curved armrests, straight legs, open and light, compact
Feel: relaxed, inviting, simple
Goes with: stone or wood decking, green plants, neutral textiles; patios and porches

Type: three-seat tufted sofa
Use: sitting, lounging; living room
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: woven textured fabric, polished chrome metal legs
Colors: dark teal blue, silver
Shape: three button-tufted back cushions, long single bench seat, flared sloping track arms, slim tapered metal legs, raised and light
Feel: tailored, rich, calm
Goes with: white or warm grey walls, walnut wood, brass or chrome accents; mid-century or modern rooms

Type: two-seat track arm sofa
Use: sitting, lounging; living room, den
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: woven textured fabric, removable cushions, wooden bun feet
Colors: dark navy blue, warm brown feet
Shape: square track arms, two loose back and seat cushions, boxy frame, short round wooden feet, solid and sturdy
Feel: cozy, casual, dependable
Goes with: white or light grey walls, light wood, warm brass accents; modern family living rooms

Type: rounded tufted loveseat settee
Use: sitting, conversation; living room, bedroom, entryway
Style: traditional, farmhouse, classic
Materials: linen-look fabric, button tufting, exposed wood frame
Colors: light sand beige, warm honey wood
Shape: curved barrel back with deep button tufting, exposed wood trim on back and arms, single seat cushion, splayed tapered wooden legs, compact
Feel: warm, elegant, inviting
Goes with: cream walls, natural wood, linen textiles; farmhouse, French country or classic rooms

Type: two-seat track arm sofa
Use: sitting, lounging; living room, den
Style: contemporary, minimalist, mid-century modern
Materials: linen-blend woven fabric, dark wooden tapered legs
Colors: light warm greige, dark brown legs
Shape: slim track arms, two loose back cushions, two seat cushions, clean boxy frame, short tapered wooden legs, medium size
Feel: calm, soft, airy
Goes with: white walls, oak or walnut, soft neutral textiles; Scandinavian or modern rooms

Type: oversized two-seat sofa
Use: sitting, lounging; living room
Style: modern, Japandi, minimalist
Materials: textured woven fabric, black wood frame and legs
Colors: medium grey, black
Shape: low wide body, thick padded arms on an exposed dark wood frame, two seat and back cushions, straight square legs, low and bulky
Feel: grounded, calm, sophisticated
Goes with: white or concrete walls, light wood, black accents; Japandi or modern rooms

Type: L-shaped sectional with chaise

Materials: distressed leather upholstery, black metal legs
Colors: warm cognac brown, black
Shape: right-facing chaise, track arm, row of loose back cushions, long seat, slim straight metal legs, large and long
Feel: warm, relaxed, rugged
Goes with: white or brick walls, walnut wood, black metal; industrial or mid-century rooms

Type: leather lounge armchair
Use: sitting, reading; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: aniline leather upholstery, wooden tapered legs
Colors: warm caramel tan, reddish brown legs
